name: POPR 5301
title: Policy Practice: Foundational Processes
description: Fundamentals of social work policy practice include phases of policy practice; analytical and interactional skills; the conscious use of self; as well as persistence, creativity, and pragmatism in pursuit of policy change. The course emphasizes the use of policy practice to foster justice through an anti-oppressive lens and implement and evaluate effective social service policies and programs. Required course for students in the Policy Practice concentration.
